title: THE SAGAN SERIES - The Frontier Is Everywhere
summary: A short unofficial NASA-style spot from Reid Gower's Sagan Series, setting Carl Sagan's words about humanity spreading through the Solar System to visuals and music.
why: Recommended as a motivating, long-horizon vision that puts everyday concerns in perspective.

quote.text: It gives me the motivation to work towards a goal which lies tens, hundreds, maybe a thousand years in the future.
